mapper.select: select to_char(current_date, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일"') as to_day

select case when EXTRACT(hour from tw.work_start_time) < 12 then '오전' else '오후' end || ' ' || to_char(tw.work_start_time, 'HH24:MI') work_start_time , to_char(work_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as work_start_time2 , case when EXTRACT(hour from tw.work_end_time) < 12 then '오전' else '오후' end || ' ' || to_char(tw.work_end_time, 'HH24:MI') work_end_time, to_char(work_end_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as work_end_time2 , tw.work_real_start_time, to_char(tw.work_real_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as work_real_start_time2 , case when EXTRACT(hour from tw.work_real_start_time) < 12 then '오전' else '오후' end || ' ' || to_char(tw.work_real_start_time, 'HH24:MI') work_real_start_time3, case when EXTRACT(hour from tw.work_predict_time) < 12 then '오전' else '오후' end || ' ' || to_char(tw.work_predict_time, 'HH24:MI') work_predict_time, to_char(tw.work_predict_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as real_work_predict_time, tm.member_number as memberNumber, tm.member_name , tm.member_rank , tw.work_number , tw.work_detail , tw.work_title, tw.work_status , tw.workplace_number , tw2.workplace_name, tm.member_use from tbl_member tm join tbl_work tw on tm.member_number = tw.member_number join tbl_workplace tw2 on tw.workplace_number = tw2.workplace_number where (tm.member_number = #{memberNumber} and (date_trunc('day', tw.work_start_time) >= current_date - INTERVAL '3 day') and date_trunc('day', tw.work_start_time) <= current_date + INTERVAL '1 day') or (tm.member_number = #{memberNumber} and work_status = '진행중') UNION ALL select case when EXTRACT(hour from tv.vacation_st_date) < 12 then '오전' else '오후' end || ' ' || to_char(tv.vacation_st_date, 'HH24:MI') as work_start_time, to_char(tv.vacation_st_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as work_start_time2, '' as work_end_time, '' as work_end_time2, null::timestamp as work_real_start_time, null as work_real_start_time2, null as work_real_start_time3, case when EXTRACT(hour from tv.vacation_end_date) < 12 then '오전' else '오후' end || ' ' || to_char(tv.vacation_end_date, 'HH24:MI') as work_predict_time, to_char(tv.vacation_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as real_work_predict_time, tm.member_number as memberNumber, tm.member_name, tm.member_rank, null::integer as work_number, '' as work_detail, '야간 후 휴식' as work_title, '야간휴식' as work_status, null::integer as workplace_number, '' as workplace_name, tm.member_use from tbl_vacation tv join tbl_member tm on tv.member_number = tm.member_number where tv.vacation_check = 'N' and tv.member_number = #{memberNumber} and date_trunc('day', tv.vacation_st_date) >= current_date - INTERVAL '3 day' and date_trunc('day', tv.vacation_st_date) <= current_date + INTERVAL '1 day' order by work_start_time2 asc
select to_char(work_start_time, 'HH24:MI') as work_start_time from tbl_work tw join tbl_member tm on tw.member_number = tm.member_number where tw.work_number = #{workNumber}

select workplace_number , workplace_name from tbl_workplace tw
and workplace_name like concat('%', #{workplaceName}, '%')
order by workplace_name collate "ko_KR.utf8"

select tm.member_number as memberNumber, tm.member_name , tm.member_rank , tw.work_number , case when EXTRACT(hour from tw.work_start_time) < 12 then '오전' else '오후' end || ' ' || to_char(tw.work_end_time, 'HH24:MI') work_start_time , case when EXTRACT(hour from tw.work_end_time) < 12 then '오전' else '오후' end || ' ' || to_char(tw.work_end_time, 'HH24:MI') work_end_time, to_char(work_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as work_start_time2 , to_char(work_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as work_start_time3 , to_char(work_end_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as work_end_time2 , tw.work_detail , tw.work_status , tw.workplace_number , tw2.workplace_name, tm.member_use, case when EXTRACT(hour from tw.work_predict_time) < 12 then '오전' else '오후' end || ' ' || to_char(tw.work_predict_time, 'HH24:MI') work_predict_time, to_char(tw.work_predict_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as real_work_predict_time , to_char(tw.work_real_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as work_real_start_time2 , tw.work_title, tw.work_real_start_time from tbl_member tm join tbl_work tw on tm.member_number = tw.member_number join tbl_workplace tw2 on tw.workplace_number = tw2.workplace_number where date_trunc('day', tw.work_start_time) >= current_date - INTERVAL '3 day' order by tw.work_real_start_time asc

SELECT vacation_number, member_number, CASE WHEN vacation_check = 'H' THEN TO_CHAR(vacation_st_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN vacation_check = 'O' THEN TO_CHAR(vacation_st_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE '' END AS vacation_st_date , TO_CHAR(vacation_st_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as vacation_st_date2, CASE WHEN vacation_check = 'H' THEN TO_CHAR(vacation_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN vacation_check = 'O' THEN TO_CHAR(vacation_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE '' END AS vacation_end_date, TO_CHAR(vacation_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as vacation_end_date2, vacation_check FROM tbl_vacation tv

SELECT vacation_number, member_number, CASE WHEN vacation_check = 'H' THEN TO_CHAR(vacation_st_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN vacation_check = 'O' THEN TO_CHAR(vacation_st_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE '' END AS vacation_st_date , TO_CHAR(vacation_st_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as vacation_st_date2, CASE WHEN vacation_check = 'H' THEN TO_CHAR(vacation_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN vacation_check = 'O' THEN TO_CHAR(vacation_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE '' END AS vacation_end_date, TO_CHAR(vacation_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as vacation_end_date2, vacation_check FROM tbl_vacation tv WHERE vacation_number = #{vacationNumber}

SELECT vacation_number, member_number, CASE WHEN vacation_check = 'H' THEN TO_CHAR(vacation_st_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN vacation_check = 'O' THEN TO_CHAR(vacation_st_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE '' END AS vacation_st_date , TO_CHAR(vacation_st_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as vacation_st_date2, CASE WHEN vacation_check = 'H' THEN TO_CHAR(vacation_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN vacation_check = 'O' THEN TO_CHAR(vacation_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE '' END AS vacation_end_date, TO_CHAR(vacation_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as vacation_end_date2, vacation_check FROM tbl_vacation tv WHERE member_number = #{memberNumber} AND vacation_check != 'N' ORDER BY vacation_st_date ASC
SELECT count(member_number) as vacation_cnt FROM tbl_vacation tv WHERE member_number = #{memberNumber} AND vacation_check != 'N'

UPDATE tbl_work SET work_end_time = work_predict_time, work_status = '종료', work_spent_time = FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(work_end_time, work_predict_time) - work_real_start_time)) / 60)::text WHERE work_status = '진행중' AND work_predict_time IS NOT NULL AND work_predict_time < current_timestamp AND work_real_start_time IS NOT NULL
UPDATE tbl_vacation SET vacation_st_date = #{vacationStDate}::timestamp, vacation_end_date = #{vacationEndDate}::timestamp WHERE member_number = #{memberNumber} AND vacation_check = 'N'
